Definition: A TASK skill that reads one rasterized PDF page image and emits the printed folio label visible on the page itself.
The page number as it appears on the page itself, not the physical PDF sequence position.
The exact visible glyph for a printed folio, or null when no folio is printed.
The producer marker for the folio label; it must be the literal string vlm.
The 1-indexed physical PDF page number echoed into the JSON page field.
The absolute path to the page PNG that is the only file read by the skill.
The path for the single page-level folio JSON file written by the skill.
A run_status emitted when a folio is visibly printed and legible.
A run_status emitted when no folio is printed, with page_label and location set to null.
A run_status emitted when required runtime overrides are missing, paths do not exist, or extensions are wrong.
A run_status emitted when the page image is unreadable, corrupt, or otherwise prevents inspection.
One of the six folio zones when page_label is present, and null when page_label is null.
A high, medium, or low label based on legibility and zone conventionality.
One short plain-English sentence describing the visual observation or failure.
The brief field is omitted because this skill has no deterministic tool dependencies.
The profile is NONE, so the skill runs in generic TASK shell mode without a profile.
The contract limiting reads to exactly IMAGE_PATH for the folio extraction worker.
The contract limiting writes to exactly OUTPUT_PATH for the folio extraction worker.
A QA invariant that a SUCCESS page_label must be visible and not derived from PAGE_NUM or neighbouring pages.
The page sequence position that must not be used as the printed folio label.
The source/producer mode for page_label_source and reasoning-first page-image inspection.
An aggregate across per-page folio JSON records handled by PDF2MD rather than the page worker.
